transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because I’ve started arranging my life around not seeing spiders, especially at home. I’ll put off doing laundry because it means going into the basement, and I avoid the garden shed completely. I’ve even paid people to do small jobs that I know I could do myself, just because I can’t make myself go into places where there might be spiders.
When you think about going into those places, is it specifically the fear of spiders that stops you?

Yes, it’s the spiders. I know, logically, that a spider in the corner of an old house probably isn’t going to hurt me. But as soon as I picture one dropping out of a box or being near the washer, it feels huge and threatening, and I get really put off. It’s embarrassing, honestly.
